Peanut Butter Chip Cookies

Ingredients

for 16 cookies

  • ⅔ cup granulated sugar (130 g)
  • ½ cup brown sugar (110 g), packed
  • ½ teaspoon salt
  • ¾ cup unsalted butter (170 g), melted
  • 2 large eggs
  • 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
  • 1 ½ cups all-purpose flour (185 g)
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • 6 oz peanut butter chips (170 g)
  • 3 oz roasted peanuts (85 g), roughly chopped

Preparation

  1. Whisk the sugars, salt and melted butter together until smooth.
  2. Whisk in the eggs and vanilla until glossy.
  3. Fold in the flour and baking soda until just combined.
  4. Stir in the peanut butter chips and peanuts, then chill the dough for 30 minutes.
  5. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
  6. Scoop the dough onto the sheets, leaving 3 inches (7.5 cm) between cookies and 1 inch (2.5 cm) from the edges.
  7. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are set.
  8. Cool on the sheets for 5 minutes before moving to a rack.
